observation_id: Stable cell_id:year key; one record per original cell per held-out year.
eligibility: eligible, unknown_label or flagged_zero_excluded. Prediction, outcome and ranking fields are null for excluded cells.
conservative_probability: Saved held-out recorded-occurrence probability after the frozen half-intercept adjustment, 0-1.
raw_probability: Saved held-out base XGBoost probability; retained as a sensitivity reference.
raw_rank_percentile: 100*(eligible_count-ordinal_rank)/(eligible_count-1); 100 is highest. Exact top-10% membership is a separate boolean using ceil(0.1*n). Ties are ordered by observation_id.
raw_top10: 1/0 for the frozen annual three-county budget; null for excluded cells.
conservative_top10: 1/0 using the same annual budget on calibrated probabilities; null for excluded cells.
priority_change: retained/entered/left/neither relative to raw; null for excluded cells.
y_reviewed: Recorded positive cell-year 1 or 0, only in the common evaluation cohort.
geometry: Original county-clipped nominal 4 km grid cell in EPSG:26912; not WUI-only.
use: Filter year before rendering. Do not combine overlapping yearly polygons in one map or interpret missing predictions as zero.
